Title 1: 01. Sales - CE Record to Report UST Led Workshop-20260928
Description: UST-led workshop on Dynamics 365 CE record-to-report flow: partner lifecycle with ZINFI, lead and opportunity management, deal registration, quoting and approvals, fulfillment visibility, and install base topics discussed on 28-Sept-2026.

Title 3: Sync authorized partner to D365 CE after ZINFI onboarding
Description: As a CRM administrator, I need to synchronize a partner to Dynamics 365 CE only after ZINFI onboarding is complete including diligence, contract, and required training, so that CE contains finalized authorized partners only.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Partner is not created in CE before final onboarding is confirmed in ZINFI.
- Sync occurs when agreed activation criteria (contract, diligence, training) are met.
- Synced partner appears in the correct legal entity.

Title 3: Link ZINFI and CE partner account identifiers
Description: As an integration owner, I need to link the ZINFI account number with the Dynamics 365 CE account record for each approved partner, so that partner data stays traceable across systems.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Each approved partner has a linked identifier in ZINFI and CE.
- Associated primary contact syncs with the account.
- Link is visible on the CE partner account.

Title 3: Restrict partner visibility by legal entity
Description: As a sales user, I need to limit partner records synced from ZINFI to visibility within the associated HeartStream legal entity or region, so that partners outside my region are not exposed.
Acceptance Criteria:
- A partner onboarded for USA is visible only in the USA legal entity.
- Users in other legal entities do not see that partner in lists or search.
- Cross-region partner scenarios are handled per agreed exception rules.

Title 3: Expose synced partners to authorized CRM sales users
Description: As a sales user, I need to allow authorized CRM users in a legal entity to view partners synced from ZINFI for that entity, so that order booking, lead, and opportunity work can use current partner data.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Authorized CRM users in the entity can open synced partner accounts.
- Partner appears in standard account search for that entity.
- Access respects existing CRM security roles.

Title 3: Capture partner training status in CE from ZINFI
Description: As an account manager, I need to synchronize required partner training and certification status from ZINFI into Dynamics 365 CE, so that partner readiness is visible for sales and service processes.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Training completion status is received from ZINFI.
- Status is linked to the correct partner and contact.
- Completed, in-progress, and expired states are distinguishable.

Title 3: Distinguish deal registration from standard opportunity
Description: As a channel manager, I need to mark and track deal registrations separately from standard opportunities in CRM, so that partner-claimed end-customer deals are identifiable.
Acceptance Criteria:
- User can indicate a deal registration on the relevant opportunity record.
- Deal registrations are searchable apart from non-registration opportunities.
- Registration is associated with the registering dealer or partner.

Title 3: Check existing deal registration for end customer
Description: As a channel manager, I need to search CRM for an existing deal registration or opportunity for an end-user customer before assisting another distributor, so that duplicate partner pursuit is avoided.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Search returns prior deal registration or opportunity for the end customer when it exists.
- User can determine which dealer holds the registration.
- Result supports channel conflict decisions.

Title 3: Apply reseller contract pricing to quotations
Description: As a sales operations user, I need to apply pricing from the active reseller contract and price group to channel partner quotations, so that quoted products reflect agreed commercial terms.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Quotation lines use contract price group where applicable.
- Products outside the contract scope are flagged or blocked per policy.
- Contract reference is traceable on the quote.

Title 3: Route non-contract quotation discounts through approval tiers
Description: As a partner account manager, I need to route quotation discount variations beyond contractual limits through a tiered approval matrix, so that pricing exceptions are controlled.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Within-contract discounts proceed without extra approval when policy allows.
- Higher discounts route to partner account manager approval.
- Largest discounts require finance approval per matrix.

Title 3: Notify approvers of pending quotation approvals
Description: As an approver, I need to receive timely notification when a quotation requires my approval, so that partner deals are not delayed.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Approver receives notification when a quote enters their approval step.
- Notification identifies quote, partner, and discount context.
- Pending items are visible in an approver work queue or equivalent.

Title 3: Skip re-approval for delivery date only changes
Description: As a sales user, I need to change only the requested delivery date on an already approved quotation without restarting the full pricing approval flow, so that schedule updates are efficient.
Acceptance Criteria:
- RDD-only change does not trigger pricing approval.
- Pricing and configuration unchanged remain as approved.
- Audit trail records the delivery date change.

Title 3: Re-approve quotation after pricing or configuration change
Description: As a sales user, I need to restart quotation approval when pricing or configuration changes before order confirmation, so that unauthorized discounts or configs are not ordered.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Price change before order confirm requires re-approval.
- Configuration change before order confirm requires re-approval.
- Cancellation or revision paths follow the same approval rules as stated in workshop.

Title 3: Synchronize fulfillment status from ERP to CRM and ZINFI
Description: As a partner user, I need to view order fulfillment status synchronized from ERP through CRM to ZINFI, so that partners see current fulfillment state in the partner portal.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Key fulfillment statuses sync ERP to CRM.
- CRM to ZINFI sync exposes current status to partners.
- Status shown matches ERP at agreed sync frequency.

Title 3: Control updates to install base device location
Description: As a service operations user, I need to follow a controlled process to update serialized install base location and customer address, so that recalls and service visits use accurate device location.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Location change requires defined ownership and validation.
- Approved updates change install base location on the serial record.
- Changes are auditable.

Title 3: Raise partner support requests from ZINFI to CRM
Description: As a partner user, I need to escalate requests from ZINFI that synchronize to Dynamics 365 CE for triage, so that HeartStream can respond to partner-raised issues.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Partner can submit escalation from ZINFI.
- Request creates or updates a case or work item in CRM.
- CRM routing assigns triage per service process.

Title 3: Support direct and indirect sales quotation paths
Description: As a sales user, I need to use CRM quotation flows for both direct HeartStream sales and indirect channel partner scenarios discussed in the workshop, so that regional models are accommodated.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Direct sales quotation path is available where discussed.
- Indirect partner quotation path respects partner-owned pricing tools where applicable.
- Regional exceptions are documented in fit-gap notes when required.

Title 3: Create CE customer record for record-to-report flow
Description: As a sales operations user, I need to create customer records in Dynamics 365 CE with the agreed identifier (CRN), so that downstream record-to-report processes receive the correct starting entity.
Acceptance Criteria:
- CE customer or account record is created per agreed CRN rules.
- Record is available to downstream order and reporting processes.
- Creation timing aligns with workshop R2R discussion.

Title 3: Track open contract examples for fit-gap analysis
Description: As a contracts analyst, I need to capture complex contract examples including pricing, discounts, rebates, and territory limits as tracked open items, so that contract fit-gap can be completed.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Complex contract samples are requested and logged as open items.
- Fit-gap disposition can be recorded when analysis completes.
- Ownership for contract examples is assigned.

Title 3: Partner master data edit ownership unresolved
Description:
Risk: Ownership and edit rights for partner master data in CE after ZINFI sync remain in parking lot.
Impact: Unauthorized changes may affect orders, credit, and contracts.
Mitigation: Define read-only default and approval path with HeartStream sales ops.

Title 3: QMS alignment for partner-reported patient events
Description:
Risk: Case creation for customer feedback and patient events may not align with QMS and partner channel.
Impact: Quality events may be missed or duplicated.
Mitigation: Align in upcoming service workshop with quality team.
